First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
B* level, a relaxed pace on rolling roads (about 1,000 feet of climbing).
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Crack o’ Dawn Friday Frolic (BTCNJ) group ride

Crack o’ Dawn Friday Frolic (BTCNJ) is a road group ride in Ridgewood, NJ. It rolls every Friday at 6:05 am from Ridgewood Starbucks.

A weekly early-morning ride from the Ridgewood Starbucks: about 21 miles of rolling roads up Saddle River Road toward Monsey and back, then coffee. The leader calls it a nice, relaxed pace.
